newsitem.title: USA: Missouri's Gov Carnahan sworn in for second term.
newsitem.headline: Missouri's Gov Carnahan sworn in for second term.

text.p: Missouri Gov. Mel Carnahan was sworn in for a second term Monday, vowing to "vigorously promote education."
Carnahan, a Democrat who handily won election Nov. 5, stressed computer training for students, outlining a goal to make "every Missouri youngster computer literate by age 12."
He pledged to equip schools with computers and link them to the information highway. He also pledged to make schools safer and to forge partnerships with businesses to improve education.
